newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyo Umpanki jumps on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: Toyo Umpanki jumps on speculative buying.

text.p: Shares of machinery maker Toyo Umpanki Co Ltd jumped in Wednesday morning trade, mainly propelled by speculative buying, traders said.
The share price gained 19 yen to 583 by 0149 GMT after briefly jumping to 590. Turnover was about 1.12 million shares.
Traders said some speculative individual investors bought the shares in an effort to push up the price by the settlement day for margin trading in the issue.
They also said the buying was backed up by Toyo Umpanki's forecast of better-than-expected earnings.

The machinery maker said on Wednesday that its earnings for the business year to March 31, 1997, would be slightly better than the forecast it announced in May, due to robust demand for its new products.
